WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval,
         AVG(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) END) AS avg_rate,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS distinct_sites
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_rates
), above AS (
  SELECT sr.avg_rate, sr.distinct_sites, o.overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_rates AS sr
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.avg_rate > o.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(distinct_sites) AS average_distinct_sites,
       AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above;
